summary: Full backend + frontend E2E tested for DriftWatch (Nginx Config Drift Tracker). Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (7 tests, 100% pass). Frontend flows verified via Playwright against public URL: auth guard redirect, JWT httpOnly cookie login, dashboard stats + Recent Runs/Incidents panels, Businesses CRUD, Business Detail node-pair create, Run Compare graceful SSH failure (timeout banner + toast), demo drift Run Detail with MOCKED Freshdesk banner + unified diff + execution log + file filters, Incidents page with MOCKED tag + status dropdowns, logout redirect. Business/node-pair delete cleanup verified. Everything works end-to-end.

minor.issue: Not idempotent - repeated calls create duplicate 'Acme Corp (Demo)' businesses and runs. Consider upserting by a demo marker so re-clicking Load Demo doesn't proliferate demo data.
status passed as query string param rather than JSON body - works but unusual REST style; also no validation that status is in {open,resolved,closed}.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: missing Description/aria-describedby on Create Business and Create Node Pair dialogs. Add DialogDescription for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional) Make /api/demo/seed idempotent to avoid duplicate demo businesses when Load Demo is clicked multiple times.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to Create Business / Create Node Pair dialogs to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: CORS middleware in server.py uses FRONTEND_URL env correctly with allow_credentials=True and explicit origin - good (not '*' with credentials).
auth.py: bcrypt password hashing (via db.hash_password) - verified working. seed_admin correctly updates existing admin password if changed.
server.py: All responses correctly strip Mongo _id via clean_doc/clean_node_pair. ssh_password never leaked in responses.
auth.py: brute-force lockout (5 attempts / 15 min per ip:email) implemented - good.
server.py: httpOnly + secure + samesite=none cookies used for cross-site cookies - correct for the preview domain.
server.py file is ~330 lines and self-contained; acceptable size. If it grows, split routers by resource.
seed_data_creation: Demo seed triggered via API (already existed). Test created & deleted UI_Test_Biz + UI_NP node pair as part of the flow.
